Akamai and Anthropic Sign $11.6 Billion Cloud Services Deal

Akamai Technologies has signed a seven-year cloud services agreement with Anthropic valued at $11.6 billion. As part of the deal, Akamai will also grant Anthropic a warrant for up to a 5% stake in the company.
